gate.syncBlocked: Paused while reconnecting to live updates.
gate.dmControlsTurns: The DM controls turn order — wait for them to end your turn.
gate.measureNoGridScale: Set a grid scale first to measure distances.
gate.advDisRequiresLoneD20: Advantage and disadvantage only apply to a single d20 roll.
gate.needsCombatantsToStart: Add at least one combatant before starting.
gate.needsInitiativeToStart: Roll initiative for all combatants before starting.
gate.undoNothingToUndo: This is the first turn — there's nothing earlier to undo.
gate.safetyHold: The table has called a safety pause — combat actions are paused until it's resolved.
